title: CE69013: Planning And Design Of Env. Engg. Facilities
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Design of water supply systems: Selection of site for the source of water
supply, design of units for sedimentation, coagulation, flocculation, Granular
media filtration, disinfection, water softening, advanced tertiary treatments,
design of city water supply pumping and distribution system.
